name: Marukai
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Marukai holds the Horde's beachhead against the Wrathtail naga. The Darkspear troll directs the fight along Ashenvale's foggy northwest coast.

sections.title: Holding the Strand
sections.body: Marukai works to keep Zoram'gar Outpost from being overwhelmed. The encampment lies on the northern edge of the Zoram Strand, amid ancient ruins, hostile night elf territory and the restless sea. Wrathtail naga rise in force from the waters and elven ruins to claim the shoreline. Marukai sends Horde champions to drive them back into the tide and take their heads, so the outpost can hold the coast.

faq.answer: Marukai is a Darkspear jungle troll defending the Horde's isolated Zoram'gar Outpost on Ashenvale's northwestern shore.

faq.q: Why is Marukai fighting the naga?
faq.answer: Wrathtail naga have overrun the nearby Zoram Strand and surrounding ruins. Marukai hires adventurers to hunt them and thin their ranks, securing the outpost's borders and the Horde's hold on the coast.
Marukai stands with her kin at Zoram'gar Outpost, at the mouth of the Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale, just south of the submerged ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.

angles.text: In night elf territory, Marukai anchors one of the Horde's most precarious coastal camps. She depends on allied champions to keep the local naga from overrunning their position.
Far from the warm echoes of Sen'jin Village, Marukai carries the Darkspear tribe's resilience. Her people carve out fortified footholds for the Horde across Kalimdor.
